subsystems.name: Foundation model
subsystems.role: the reasoning core that reads a goal and decides what to do next.

subsystems.name: Planner
subsystems.role: breaks a goal into ordered sub-tasks and revises the plan as results come back.

subsystems.name: Tool and action layer
subsystems.role: lets the agent actually change something in the world.

subsystems.name: Memory and state
subsystems.role: keeps context across long runs without overflowing the model's window.

subsystems.name: Verification and guardrails
subsystems.role: checks whether an action worked and whether it was allowed.

subsystems.name: Orchestration runtime
subsystems.role: schedules steps, retries failures and reports what happened.

buildSteps.title: Define the task and its success test
buildSteps.detail: Narrow the job to something checkable — a passing test suite, a filled form, a reconciled ledger — because an agent can only self-correct against a measurable outcome.

buildSteps.title: Pick and wire the base models
buildSteps.detail: Choose a model strong enough at tool calling and long context, then route easier sub-tasks to smaller, cheaper models.

buildSteps.title: Expose tools
buildSteps.detail: Wrap each capability as a documented function with typed arguments and clear error messages, so the model can call it and understand failures.

buildSteps.title: Build the plan–act–observe loop
buildSteps.detail: The model writes a plan, emits one or a few tool calls, reads the results, and updates the plan; a step budget and timeout stop runaway loops.

buildSteps.title: Add memory
buildSteps.detail: Summarise old context, persist facts and intermediate artefacts to a store, and retrieve only what the current step needs.

buildSteps.title: Insert a verifier
buildSteps.detail: A separate critic model or deterministic check inspects each result; failed checks trigger a retry, a replan, or a hand-off to a human.

buildSteps.title: Sandbox and permission
buildSteps.detail: Run code and commands in a container with least-privilege credentials, hard limits on money and data access, and an immutable action log.

buildSteps.title: Evaluate before shipping
buildSteps.detail: Run the agent against held-out tasks and adversarial inputs, measuring task success, cost per task, and how often it does something harmful.

buildSteps.title: Deploy with oversight
buildSteps.detail: Start on reversible, low-stakes work with human approval at key checkpoints, then widen autonomy only where measured reliability supports it.

prerequisites.tech: Long-context models with reliable tool calling
prerequisites.why: without dependable structured output the planner cannot drive tools or read their results.
agents grant real action; isolation is what keeps mistakes from becoming damage.
task suites exist for coding and browsing, but they under-measure long-horizon reliability and side effects.
models are poor judges of their own errors, so long chains drift without an external checker.
emerging conventions let agents discover tools and act on a user's behalf safely and revocably.

pathway.milestone: single-domain agents over APIs and code with human-in-the-loop approval
pathway.unlocks: automation of well-specified, reversible back-office workflows.

pathway.milestone: long-horizon reliability — agents that finish multi-hour tasks without drifting
pathway.unlocks: delegation of whole projects rather than individual steps.

pathway.milestone: standardised tool, identity and permission layers
pathway.unlocks: agents that can be trusted with credentials and spend across many systems.
wider deployment where a wrong action is expensive or irreversible.
